user.description: User account under which the memcached process runs.

bind_address.description: IP address for memcached to bind to. Use 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces (not recommended without firewall).

port.description: TCP port number to listen on.

max_memory_mb.description: Maximum memory (in megabytes) to allocate for item storage.

max_item_size_mb.description: Maximum size of a single item in megabytes. Set to 0 for unlimited size (not recommended).

num_threads.description: Number of worker threads. Set to 0 to disable threading (single-threaded mode).

max_open_files.description: Maximum number of open file descriptors. Ensure system limits support this value.

foreground.description: Run in foreground instead of daemonizing. Useful for containerized deployments or debugging.

log_file.description: Path to a log file. If empty, logs go to stderr (or syslog depending on system).

udp_enabled.description: Enable UDP support. Only enable if required (UDP is rarely used and has security implications).

udp_max_payload.description: Maximum UDP payload size in bytes. Only applies if UDP is enabled.

disable_sasl.description: Disable SASL authentication (SASL must be compiled-in to have effect).

local_only.description: Restrict connections to localhost only (via Unix socket or 127.0.0.1).

pid_file.description: Path to the PID file. Must be writable by the memcached user.

slab_page_size.description: Size of a slab page (in bytes). Must be a power of two. Default is 1 MB.

slab_chunk_size.description: Minimum size of a chunk in a slab (in bytes). Default is 48 bytes.

use_large_pages.description: Enable use of large memory pages (requires root and system support).

disable_mlock.description: Disable memory locking (mlockall). Set to false only if locking is desired (requires CAP_IPC_LOCK).

enable_all_evictions.description: Allow evictions of all items, not just LRU. Use with caution.

idle_timeout.description: Idle timeout (seconds) before closing a client connection. 0 means no timeout.

check_nulls.description: Check for null bytes in stored data. Helps detect corruption but adds overhead.

extra_options.description: Additional command-line options to pass to memcached (e.g., ['-b 2048'] for TCP backlog).

items.description: A single memcached command-line flag (e.g., '-b 2048' for max TCP backlog, '-c 1024' for max connections override).
